_description: Inspiration / inheritance (spark) odds. Single source of truth for both the sim (career_bot.career_simulator inheritance model) and the front end (public/app.js inspiration-odds display). Edit here, not in code.

blue_stat_roll._note: Per-activation stat amount a Blue spark grants when it procs (inclusive range, picked uniformly).

lineage_node_weights._note: Per-node relative proc weight. uma.guide states parents proc higher than grandparents but does NOT publish exact node probabilities; these are this project's estimate, used only for ranking parents in the UI / sim approximation.
